page.overview:
Who is Chief?

The Chief is the leader of the soldiers stationed at Tequila Wolf.

The chief is a heavily obese man with a thick black mustache, a wide nose, a prominent brow ridge with no eyebrows, and a scar above his left eye. He wears a red uniform with World Government symbols on the collar, a dark red cape and a black cap with long ear flaps lined with fur.

The chief is a callous individual, indifferent to the suffering and conditions of the slaves at Tequila Wolf. He does not appear to be particularly knowledgeable about the world outside his country, as he failed to recognize Nico Robin. In the anime, he was shown to be quite a cowardly person when the situation got out of control, and hid, shaking in fear.

As the chief of the prison labor camp at Tequila Wolf, the chief has command over the armed troops stationed in the country.
